# SHRINEVA: full site content

> SHRINEVA is a commercial building for rent or lease at Plot No. D-15, Lalpur Housing Scheme, Bada Lalpur, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh 221003, India, opposite the upcoming Apollo Hospital and about 100 m from NIFT Varanasi, on a 24 m wide north-facing road. Three open-plan floors of about 3,500 sq ft gross (about 3,100 sq ft carpet) with flexible tenant layouts can be rented or leased whole or in part. The concrete structure is complete; project completion is targeted for March 2027, subject to approvals. Images labelled as renders are indicative.

Last updated: November 2026 (2026-11-20). Source: https://shrineva.in/. Short version: https://shrineva.in/llms.txt.

## Key facts
- Address: Plot No. D-15, Lalpur Housing Scheme, Bada Lalpur, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh 221003, India.
- GPS coordinates: 25.383306, 82.978028.
- Leasing phone: +91 81140 80609 (also WhatsApp, https://wa.me/918114080609) and +91 73557 70378. Leasing email: leasing@shrineva.in.
- Location: opposite the upcoming Apollo Hospital (under construction, not yet operational) and about 100 m from the NIFT Varanasi campus, on a 24 m wide north-facing road in Bada Lalpur, about 1 km from Ring Road (NH 135B).
- Plot and road: 525 sq m plot with about 50 ft of frontage on a 24 m wide road.
- Floors: three upper floors, each about 3,500 sq ft gross and about 3,100 sq ft carpet. Open-plan commercial floor plates with flexible tenant layouts, offered as open shells to rent or lease whole or in part. Areas are approximate.
- Building: one 10-passenger lift, a fire exit on every level, Vastu-compliant layout, parking for 12+ cars at ground level.
- Approval: shown on the site as "VDA approved" (Varanasi Development Authority). Sanction details are not published on the site; ask the leasing team.
- Project status (November 2026): the concrete structure is complete; brickwork, façade, lift and services are in progress; project completion is targeted for March 2027, subject to approvals. Dates are targets and may change. Images labelled as renders are indicative and the design is subject to change.
- Use of any floor is subject to floor suitability and applicable statutory approvals (municipal, fire and, for food businesses, FSSAI).

## Project status and timeline
Status as of November 2026. The concrete structure is complete. Brickwork, façade, lift and services are in progress, and project completion is targeted for March 2027, subject to approvals.
1. Concrete structure: Complete. Ground level and three upper floors.
2. Brickwork, façade, lift and services: In progress. The current stage of work on site.
3. Final works: Upcoming. Ground and boundary works, flooring and other finishing.
4. Project completion: Target: March 2027. Subject to approvals.
- Want changes to your floor? Tell the leasing team early. Changes a tenant asks for are agreed during leasing and the works continue to suit, so completion for that floor follows the agreed scope.
- Status as of November 2026. Dates are targets and may change. The photographs show the building as it stands; renders elsewhere on this site are indicative.
- Site photographs (taken November 2026) are on https://shrineva.in/#status: The building today; Ground level; Upper floor, looking south; Upper floor, looking north; View towards the upcoming Apollo Hospital site; View towards NIFT; The frame with lights.

## The building and the floors
### Ground level
About 3,000 sq ft (Open to the road, parking for 12+ cars; About 279 sq m).
- Floor to floor: About 9.5 ft
- Frontage: about 50 ft on a 24 m road
- Parking: For 12+ cars
- Entries: West and east, to the lift and stair lobby
- Lift: 10-passenger lift, serves every level
- Fire exit: On every level

### Floors 1, 2 and 3 (identical)
About 3,500 sq ft (Gross, on each of Floors 1, 2 and 3; About 3,100 sq ft carpet).
- Floors: 1, 2 and 3 are identical
- Floor to floor: About 11.5 ft
- Front: Glass front facing the road
- Lift: 10-passenger lift, serves every level
- Fire exit: On every level
- Condition: Open shell, fitted out by the tenant

### Stack
- Floor 3: About 3,500 sq ft. Open floor plate, glass front on the road (For lease).
- Floor 2: About 3,500 sq ft. Open floor plate, glass front on the road (For lease).
- Floor 1: About 3,500 sq ft. Open floor plate, glass front on the road (For lease).
- Ground: About 3,000 sq ft. Covered parking for 12+ cars, entries and lift lobby (Parking and entry).

### What can be leased
- A whole floor
- Part of a floor
- More than one floor
- about 3,500 sq ft gross per floor (about 3,100 sq ft carpet), in one open floor plate
- Full-floor lease or subdivision, subject to requirement
- Long-term leases accepted
- Commercial use across Floors 1, 2 and 3, subject to floor suitability and applicable statutory approvals
- Fit-out and floor condition agreed with each occupier
- Brand visibility on a 24 m road, signage and ground-level parking

### How leasing works
1. Tell us what you need: Area, use and timing. Use the form, call or WhatsApp.
2. See it: Floor options, the brochure and a visit to the plot.
3. Agree the terms: Commercial terms, fit-out and floor condition, in writing.

## Safety and access
### Fire safety and escape
- Fire exit: On every level, marked on the plans
- Staircase: 5′-3″ wide flights from the ground level to Floor 3
- Open sides: Open setbacks on all four sides of the building
- Front setback: 15′-8″ between the building and the road side

### Access and circulation
- Passenger lift: One 10-passenger lift, serving every level
- Lift and stair lobby: One core on the east side, reached by west and east walkways
- Parking: Covered, at ground level, for 12+ cars
- Frontage: About 50 ft on a 24 m wide north-facing road

### The building
- Height: Ground level plus three floors
- Floor to floor: About 11.5 ft on Floors 1 to 3, about 9.5 ft at ground level
- Floor plate: Open-plan commercial floor plates with flexible tenant layouts
- Front: Glass front facing the road
- Orientation: Vastu compliant
- Approval: VDA approved

Not stated on the site, so ask the leasing team: Fire-fighting systems and clearances; Power and backup supply; Water supply; Fibre and connectivity; Floor condition and fit-out.

- NIFT Varanasi campus: ≈ 100 m (Near the plot)

- Varanasi Trade Centre: ≈ 330 m (Along the road)
- Vardhan Hospital, Lalpur: Nearby (Bada Lalpur, opposite the Trade Centre)
- Ring Road (NH 135B): ≈ 1 km (By road)
- Ganjari Cricket Stadium: ≈ 20 km (By road, approx.)

**Is SHRINEVA suitable for a clinic, pathology lab or diagnostic centre?** SHRINEVA offers open-plan commercial floor plates of about 3,100 sq ft carpet directly opposite the upcoming Apollo Hospital on a 24-metre-wide north-facing road, with a 10-passenger lift, a fire exit on every level and 12+ car parking. The hospital is under construction and not yet operational. Healthcare use is subject to floor suitability and statutory approvals.

- Directly opposite an upcoming hospital: The Apollo Hospital across the 24 m road is under construction and not yet operational. SHRINEVA makes no footfall claim; the location is simply opposite the site.
- Open-plan commercial floor plates: Each upper floor is about 3,500 sq ft gross (about 3,100 sq ft carpet) in one open plate, which can be planned for consulting rooms, sample collection, reporting and waiting areas. Part-floor leasing is possible.
- Lift and fire exit: One 10-passenger lift serves all floors, and every level has a dedicated fire exit.
- Parking and road access: Parking for 12+ cars at ground level and about 50 ft of frontage on a 24-metre-wide road.
- Healthcare operators who can enquire: Pathology laboratories; Diagnostic centres; Specialist clinics; Other healthcare operators.

**Is the Apollo Hospital next to SHRINEVA already open?** No. The Apollo Hospital opposite SHRINEVA is upcoming and under construction, so it is not yet operational. SHRINEVA therefore makes no claim about patient footfall. Healthcare tenants should plan around the building’s own specifications and the approvals their operation needs.

**Can SHRINEVA host a pathology lab or diagnostic centre?** Open floors of about 3,100 sq ft carpet can be planned for lab or diagnostic layouts, with a 10-passenger lift and fire exits on every level. Suitability depends on the chosen floor and the applicable statutory approvals for your operation. Share your requirement and we will confirm feasibility at a site visit.

**Can I lease part of a floor for a clinic?** Yes. Floors can be leased whole or in part, so a clinic can take a section of one floor. Part-floor sizes and availability are confirmed when you enquire, and each use remains subject to floor suitability and applicable statutory approvals.

### Office, Bank & Coaching
Page: https://shrineva.in/office-bank-coaching-space
Bare-Shell Office, Bank Branch & Coaching Institute Space in Varanasi. Three open-shell floors on a 24 m wide north-facing road in Bada Lalpur: lease a whole floor, part of a floor or several floors.

**What office, bank or coaching space does SHRINEVA offer in Varanasi?** SHRINEVA offers three open-shell floors of about 3,500 sq ft gross (about 3,100 sq ft carpet) each on a 24-metre-wide north-facing road in Bada Lalpur, with about 50 ft of frontage, a 10-passenger lift, 12+ car parking and a fire exit on every level. Lease a whole floor, part of a floor, or several floors.

- Frontage and parking for branches: About 50 ft of frontage on a 24 m road and parking for 12+ cars suit customer-facing branches. Bank, ATM and NBFC formats depend on the operator’s own requirements and approvals.
- Open plates for offices: Open-plan floor plates with flexible tenant layouts let corporate, IT and consulting teams plan their own space. The floors are open shells, so the fit-out is yours.
- Space for institutes and coworking: A whole floor can be divided into classrooms or workspaces. NIFT Varanasi is about 100 m away, and Deendayal Hastkala Sankul (Varanasi Trade Centre) is nearby.
- Lift, fire exit and Vastu: A 10-passenger lift, a fire exit on every level and a Vastu-compliant layout.
- Businesses who can enquire: Banks, ATMs and NBFCs; Insurance branches; Corporate and regional offices; IT companies and consulting firms; Coaching, education and training institutes; Coworking operators.
- Use of any floor is subject to floor suitability and applicable statutory approvals.

**Are the SHRINEVA floors fully fitted offices?** No. The upper floors are open shells, so tenants fit them out to their own layout, branding and requirements while construction at the building is ongoing. Fit-out scope, timelines and completion terms are agreed with each tenant during leasing discussions, so please share your space plan early.

**Can I lease more than one floor at SHRINEVA?** Yes. Floors can be leased whole, in part, or as multiple floors. The three upper floors share the same open layout of about 3,500 sq ft gross, which helps teams that expect to grow across floors. Availability and terms are confirmed when you enquire.

**Is there parking for staff and visitors?** SHRINEVA provides parking for 12+ cars at ground level, with about 50 ft of frontage on a 24-metre-wide road. Exact parking arrangements for each tenant, including how many spaces suit your staff and visitor numbers, are confirmed during leasing discussions and the site visit.

## Frequently asked questions
### Where can I lease commercial space in Bada Lalpur, Varanasi?
SHRINEVA is a commercial building on a 24 m wide north-facing road in Bada Lalpur, Varanasi, opposite the upcoming Apollo Hospital and about 100 metres from NIFT Varanasi. Three open floors of about 3,500 sq ft gross can be leased whole or in part, with a 10-passenger lift, parking for 12+ cars and about 50 ft of frontage.

### Where is SHRINEVA located in Varanasi and how wide is the access road?
SHRINEVA is at Plot No. D-15, Lalpur Housing Scheme, Bada Lalpur, Varanasi 221003, directly opposite the upcoming Apollo Hospital and about 100 metres from the NIFT Varanasi campus. It has about 50 ft of frontage on a 24-metre-wide north-facing road, with quick connectivity to the Varanasi Ring Road.

### What is the carpet area and gross area per floor at SHRINEVA?
Each of the three upper floors has about 3,500 sq ft gross area and about 3,100 sq ft carpet area as open-plan commercial floor plates with flexible tenant layouts. Floors can be leased whole or in part. Areas are approximate and subject to final measurement, and the floors are offered as open shells while construction is ongoing.

### How much car parking and lift capacity does SHRINEVA provide?
SHRINEVA offers parking for 12+ cars at ground level and one 10-passenger lift serving every floor. Each level has a dedicated fire exit, and the layout is Vastu-compliant. Exact parking and floor arrangements for a tenant are confirmed during the site visit and leasing discussion.

### Which businesses can lease space at SHRINEVA?
SHRINEVA suits pathology labs, diagnostic centres and clinics; banks, NBFCs and insurance branches; corporate and IT offices; retail showrooms and boutiques; restaurants and cafés; and coaching institutes, coworking, fitness and wellness centres. Every use is subject to floor suitability and applicable statutory approvals, including municipal, fire and FSSAI approvals for food businesses.

## हिंदी (Hindi)
बड़ा लालपुर, वाराणसी में किराये और लीज़ पर कमर्शियल स्पेस. निर्माणाधीन Apollo Hospital के सामने और NIFT वाराणसी से लगभग 100 मीटर दूर, 24 मीटर चौड़ी उत्तरमुखी सड़क पर। पूरी मंज़िलें, लगभग 3,500 वर्ग फुट।

**बड़ा लालपुर, वाराणसी में कमर्शियल स्पेस किराये पर कहाँ मिलेगा?** SHRINEVA बड़ा लालपुर में, 24 मीटर चौड़ी उत्तरमुखी सड़क पर, निर्माणाधीन Apollo Hospital के ठीक सामने और NIFT वाराणसी से लगभग 100 मीटर दूर है। तीन ऊपरी मंज़िलों में से हर एक लगभग 3,500 वर्ग फुट (लगभग 3,100 वर्ग फुट कारपेट) की खुली फ़्लोर प्लेट है, जिसे पूरा या हिस्से में किराये या लीज़ पर लिया जा सकता है।

**SHRINEVA में कितना क्षेत्रफल किराये पर मिल सकता है?** तीन ऊपरी मंज़िलों में से हर एक लगभग 3,500 वर्ग फुट ग्रॉस और लगभग 3,100 वर्ग फुट कारपेट है। पूरी मंज़िल या उसका हिस्सा लिया जा सकता है। हिस्से का आकार और उपलब्धता पूछताछ पर लीज़ टीम तय करती है। क्षेत्रफल अनुमानित है।

**क्या सामने का Apollo Hospital चालू हो चुका है?** नहीं। सामने का Apollo Hospital निर्माणाधीन है और अभी चालू नहीं है। इसलिए SHRINEVA मरीज़ों की आवाजाही का कोई दावा नहीं करता और अस्पताल के चालू होने की कोई तारीख़ भी नहीं बताता।

**क्या सिर्फ़ मंज़िल का हिस्सा किराये पर मिल सकता है?** हाँ। मंज़िलें पूरी या हिस्से में दी जा सकती हैं, इसलिए छोटी ज़रूरत वाला व्यवसाय एक मंज़िल का हिस्सा ले सकता है। हिस्से का आकार और उपलब्धता पूछताछ के समय बताई जाती है, और हर उपयोग मंज़िल की उपयुक्तता व अनुमतियों के अधीन रहता है।

**यहाँ किस तरह के व्यवसाय आ सकते हैं?** क्लिनिक, पैथोलॉजी लैब, बैंक और NBFC शाखाएँ, कॉर्पोरेट व IT ऑफिस, शोरूम, कैफ़े और रेस्तरां, कोचिंग संस्थान, कोवर्किंग और फिटनेस सेंटर। किसी भी उपयोग के लिए मंज़िल की उपयुक्तता और लागू वैधानिक अनुमतियाँ देखी जाएँगी; खाने के व्यवसाय को FSSAI भी चाहिए।

**निर्माण की स्थिति क्या है और चित्र कैसे हैं?** निर्माण जारी है। वेबसाइट के चित्र और वॉकथ्रू अंतिम डिज़ाइन के संकेतात्मक 3D रेंडर हैं; फिनिश, साइनेज और आसपास का दृश्य सिर्फ़ उदाहरण है और डिज़ाइन बदल सकता है। साइट की असली तस्वीरें वॉकथ्रू पेज पर हैं।

**साइट विज़िट कैसे तय करें?** +91 81140 80609 पर कॉल या WhatsApp करें, या इसी पेज से विज़िट बुक करें। लीज़ टीम आपके साथ समय तय करेगी।
